prompt:
Paint ONE building for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map, in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the roof is seen from above (it fills the upper coloured block of the guide) and the front wall is seen straight on (the lower block). The attached image is an exact layout guide drawn at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the roof/wall split line, the door (dark brown rectangle: it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level, a real door you can walk through) and the windows (yellow rectangles) in exactly the same places. You may add small details (eaves, trim, drainpipe, flower boxes, crates by the wall, a chimney poking above the roof into the empty top margin).
This building: a one-storey house in a hidden forgotten village deep in a mossy forest (small bark-clad huts, moss and ferns growing on the roofs). roof so overgrown with thick green moss and small ferns that the shingles barely show walls clad in rough bark slabs with a mossy stone base. Windows have small panes glowing warm amber from inside (the only light). The whole image is 176 x 160 art pixels (each art pixel 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No ground, no shadow, no people, no text, no letters.
revised_prompt: Edit the user-provided layout-guide image into ONE finished isolated game building sprite. Use the attached image as a STRICT pixel-coordinate template, not loose inspiration. Canvas 1232 x 1120 image pixels corresponding exactly to 176 x 160 art pixels, each art pixel exactly 7x7 image pixels; hard-edged nearest-neighbor square pixels ONLY. Transparent alpha everywhere currently bright magenta. Preserve exact guide silhouette and registered geometry: roof spans image x14–1218, y196–714 (roof upper plane y196–422 and lower visible roof slope y437–714, with dark eave/split strip y423–436); front wall x56–1176 from y715 to bottom y1119. Maintain roof/front-wall separation precisely at y715. The front-wall DOOR is at x553–679, y938–1119, a grounded real walk-through dark brown rectangular door, precisely same dimensions and position as guide, with dark framing; do NOT shift or shrink it, and door runs all the way to bottom edge. A SINGLE WINDOW at x350–462, y896–1036, exactly matching the yellow window's location and size; amber glowing panes contained within this footprint. No additional windows. Restyle as a one-storey house in a forgotten hidden mossy forest village: roof thoroughly carpeted in thick overlapping moss in rich olive/emerald/forest greens, tiny sculpted pixel fern fronds, only scattered glimpses of bark shingles; flat-to-sloped roof structure as template, emphatic crisp horizontal eave. Vertical front wall clad in layered rough bark slabs, earthy brown to purple-brown recesses and warm tan small highlights; irregular mossy stone footing near bottom around door. Small timber mullions in the one warmly amber window, unlit exterior otherwise. A few small tasteful moss clumps, knot patterns and wooden framing; optional small details only if they don't alter the major outlined geometry. Classic three-quarter top-down JRPG building asset: roof seen from above, wall straight on. Premium modern hi-bit hand-placed 2D pixel art, clusters of 3–10 uniformly sized pixels, strongly designed distinct readable shapes, no checkerboard dithering, no noise, no blur, no antialias, no soft brushes, no photographic texture. Hue shifted 4–6 shades each material, saturated purple-red shadows and warm yellow highlights, rich earthy palette. Soft neutral even overhead-left overcast light; NO cast shadows, no night darkness, no lamp light pool, no vignette. Absolutely NO ground, NO people, NO lettering. Fully transparent background, not magenta.
